name: ghostdm
description: Client-side encryption overlay for Instagram Web DMs.

scripts.build:chrome: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp public/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp public/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp -R public/icons dist/icons && esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --target=chrome120
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && mkdir -p dist-firefox && cp public/manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp public/popup.html dist-firefox/popup.html && cp -R public/icons dist-firefox/icons && esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist-firefox --format=iife --target=firefox120
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package: rm -rf artifacts && mkdir -p artifacts && npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename ghostdm-chrome.zip --overwrite-dest && npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename ghostdm-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest

author: Nolan Cotter
